name: Harukawa Kokoa
source:
A coquettish seiso gyaru.

She has a bright personality and has many friends, both male and female. She has a tendency to hassle and tease those she finds interesting. She is interested in beauty-related matters, and hopes to have her own beauty salon in the future. She wanted to join Squeeze Girls because it sounded fun. Her talent was recognized by Moka, and she is now their ace.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/erom/index.html#CHARACTER]official website[/url]]
